findings.title: Case-variant lookup can convert wrong project
findings.problem: _find_application returns only first() among active case-variant applications, ordered exact-name first then by name. If the user already owns a personal case-variant and a non-personal variant sorts first, the relaxed _is_reusable now accepts the non-personal one and converts it, so the user ends with two personal projects.
findings.impact: Before this change that state raised ValueError; now a second project is silently taken over and made personal (if it has no other members). Reachability was not confirmed: project_service.py:239 blocks new case-insensitive duplicates, so it needs legacy duplicate data.
findings.recommendation: When a non-personal case variant is found, also check whether the user already owns a personal case-variant (look up all active variants, not only first()); if so raise ValueError instead of converting.
findings.check_notes: personal_project_service.py:207-226 and :281-284 add _ensure_no_other_own_personal_variant before converting a case-variant; it raises ValueError if the user already owns a personal variant (new repository lookup, tests added).
